pois.label: SiC 探测舱(剖切)
pois.detail: 哨兵网最深一站,与围界/玄关同款叠层:慢化片 → ⁶LiF 30 µm → 4H-SiC PiN 2×2(热道/快道)→ 铜读出 → 前放。在这个几乎没有信号的地方,SiC 的零漏电反而最要紧——本底监测仪自己的暗计数必须比洞室本底更安静,宽禁带 3.26 eV 在室温把这一项直接归零。
pois.detail_en: The deepest station of the net, same stack as the fence and foyer: moderator slab → 30 µm ⁶LiF → 2×2 4H-SiC PiN (thermal/fast) → copper readout → preamp. In a place with almost no signal, SiC's zero leakage matters most — a background monitor's own dark counts must be quieter than the cavern background, and the 3.26 eV bandgap zeroes that term at room temperature.

specs.SiC 片: 4×1 cm²,50 µm 外延 PiN(LGAD 同外延栈)
specs.转换层: ⁶LiF 30 µm(**95% ⁶Li 富集**),效率 4.7%
specs.本征暗计数: ~0(300 K 生成电流 <1e-27 A 量级,账4;绝对值依赖自设有效态密度,比值稳健)

specs_en.Intrinsic dark counts: ~0 (generation current below ~1e-27 A at 300 K, account #4; the absolute figure depends on assumed densities of states, the ratio is robust)

pois.sim: 器件账引 LGAD L2a TCAD:600 V 反向 IV 全程 1e-31 A/µm——在 TCAD 里漏电低到击穿都无法从 IV 曲线读出。哨兵沿用该外延栈的 PiN 版;增益版(d17,M≈5,dM/M 0.06%/V)留给轨道 PAN 谱仪:一次战役、两种部署。
pois.sim_en: Device account from LGAD L2a TCAD: reverse IV flat at 1e-31 A/µm to 600 V — leakage so low the breakdown cannot be read off the IV curve. The sentinel uses the PiN variant of that stack; the gain variant (d17, M≈5, dM/M 0.06%/V) goes to the orbital PAN spectrometer: one campaign, two deployments.
pois.physics: 生成电流 ∝ n_i ∝ exp(−Eg/2kT):4H-SiC 的 n_i ~8e-9 cm⁻³ 比硅低 ~18 个数量级,SRH 产生在室温实际不发生——不制冷的探测器在深地静得过岩石本身。
pois.physics_en: Generation current ∝ n_i ∝ exp(−Eg/2kT): with n_i ~8e-9 cm⁻³, 4H-SiC sits ~18 decades below silicon, and SRH generation effectively never happens at room temperature — an uncooled detector quieter than the rock around it.

pois.label: 计数屏 · 静默的证明
pois.detail: 这块屏几乎不动:率条全暗,唯一的活动是 4 秒的心跳灯和 ~30 秒一次的青色 DAQ 自检脉冲(标定注入,不是计数)。3000 m 岩石把 µ 通量压掉六个数量级——同款柱子在围界每 12 秒跳一次,在这里一个月才等到一跳。静默不是故障,是屏蔽账的活体证明。
pois.detail_en: This screen barely moves: the rate bar is fully dark, and the only activity is a 4 s heartbeat LED and a cyan DAQ self-test pulse every ~30 s (a calibration injection, not a count). Three kilometres of rock crush the muon flux by six decades — the identical column blips every 0.43 s at the fence and waits about a month for one here. The silence is not a fault; it is the shielding budget, alive.

specs.屏上活动: 心跳 4 s + 自检脉冲 ~30 s(非计数)

specs_en.On-screen activity: 4 s heartbeat + ~30 s self-test pulse (not counts)

pois.sim: 三层深度衰减账(design_rounds 账3):µ 道 0.05/cm²/s ×1e-6 ×8 cm² = 4e-7 cps;中子只剩裸岩 U/Th (α,n) 底 ~1e-6 n/cm²/s → 5e-8 cps;合计 ~26 天一跳。若它开始有节奏地跳,说明洞室本底出了大事——这正是它站在这里的理由。
pois.sim_en: Depth-attenuation account (design_rounds #3): muon channel 0.05/cm²/s ×1e-6 ×8 cm² = 4e-7 cps; neutrons at the bare-rock U/Th (α,n) floor ~1e-6 n/cm²/s → 5e-8 cps; ~one blip per 26 days combined. If it ever starts blipping rhythmically, the cavern background has gone badly wrong — which is exactly why it stands here.
pois.physics: µ 通量随深度指数衰减;到 3 km 只剩最高能的尾巴。这里的本底低到暗物质实验(the dark-matter experiment)敢把 70 t·yr 曝光押在'每年几十个事例'的账上——哨兵柱守的就是这笔账的前提。
pois.physics_en: Muon flux falls exponentially with depth; at 3 km only the highest-energy tail survives. The background here is low enough that the dark-matter experiment stakes a 70 t·yr exposure on a budget of tens of events per year — and this column guards that budget's premise.

pois.label: 哨兵网底层 · 三层联动
pois.label_en: Bottom tier of the sentinel net
pois.detail: 哨兵网的最深一层。三块同款屏从地表读到 -3000 m:围界 ~0.43 s 一跳、玄关 ~1 分钟偶尔一跳、这里月级一跳——探测器完全相同,读数差出 5 个数量级,深度-强度曲线就立在城里。太阳粒子事件对这块屏则是彻底的不存在:警报由天上给出(提前量只来自 com-l4-01 日冕仪的 1–3 天预报;EPS 的 ~77 min 是自由空间谱弥散间隔,非地表余量),地表柱证实次级场到达,而 3000 m 岩下没有任何 SEP 贡献通道。对这里的暗物质实验来说,这正是它需要的那句话——太阳爆发不会往它的本底里加一个计数。
pois.detail_en: The deepest tier of the net. Three identical screens read from the surface down to -3000 m: ~12 s blips at the fence, an occasional blip per minute in the foyer, monthly-scale here — the detectors are identical, the readings span five decades, and the depth-intensity curve stands built into the city. A solar particle event, meanwhile, simply does not exist for this screen: the warning is issued from orbit (lead time comes only from the com-l4-01 coronagraph's 1–3 day forecast; the polar EPS's ~77 min is a free-space dispersion interval, not ground margin), the surface column confirms the secondary field has arrived, and under 3000 m of rock there is no SEP contribution channel at all. For the dark-matter experiment down here that is exactly the sentence it needs — a solar storm adds not one count to its background.

specs.上层: sci-rad-02 围界 2.32 cps(已分辨口径)

sim: 对表(design_rounds 账3):围界→玄关,强子 e^-52、µ ×0.03;玄关→深地,µ 再 ×3e-5、中子到裸岩 radiogenic 极限 1e-6 n/cm²/s。洞里真正的本底压制主力是水罐(γ >1e4)与 Gd 液闪 veto——哨兵柱量的是它们外面的'原料本底'。
SEP 零响应账(design_rounds 账5):地表增强 F=2~1e4 全档时本柱无任何可测响应——3000 m 岩下 µ 已 ×1e-6,SEP 质子(最高 ~GeV)不存在能到达此深度的次级通道。含义直接写进曝光账:70 t·yr 的本底预算不需要为太阳活动周留任何裕度。
(**2026-09-02 换锚**:围界由自设 2 m 屏蔽档换到 tokamak 已声明的**建造厚度 0.30 m 已分辨面**;旧值 0.08 cps / 12 s 已作废,详见 sci-rad-02 卡。)
sim_en: Cross-table (design_rounds #3): fence→foyer, hadrons e^-52 and µ ×0.03; foyer→deep lab, µ another ×3e-5 and neutrons at the bare-rock radiogenic limit of 1e-6 n/cm²/s. Inside the cavern the heavy lifting is done by the water tank (γ >1e4) and the Gd-scintillator veto — this column measures the raw background outside them.

SEP zero-response account (design_rounds #5): for surface enhancements of F=2 to 1e4 this column shows no measurable response at all — muons are already ×1e-6 under 3000 m, and SEP protons (topping out near a GeV) have no secondary channel reaching this depth. The implication goes straight into the exposure ledger: the 70 t·yr background budget needs no margin for the solar cycle.
(**Re-anchored 2026-09-02**: the fence moved from the assumed-2 m shield to tokamak’s declared **0.30 m build thickness, resolved face**; the old 0.08 cps / 12 s are void — see the sci-rad-02 card.)
pois.physics: 分层监测的逻辑:每一层哨兵量自己头顶那段物质柱的透射率,三层相除就是每段岩石的实测衰减因子——城市自己的深度-强度标定,不依赖任何手册值。
pois.physics_en: The logic of tiered monitoring: each sentinel measures the transmission of the matter column directly above it, and the ratios between tiers are the measured attenuation factors of each rock section — the city's own depth-intensity calibration, independent of any handbook value.
